notes: Pictograph of a flowing stream. Appears as 氵 on the left side of characters.
Mouth radical 口 + phonetic 加 jiā. Loanword syllable — also read gā in 咖喱 (curry).
Mouth radical 口 + phonetic 非 fēi. Exists almost solely for the loanword 咖啡.
Grass radical 艹 on top marks it as a plant. Source of the English word 'chai'.
Pictograph of grains scattered on a stalk. Doubles as the metric 'meter' by sound-loan.
Food radical 饣 + phonetic 反 fǎn. Contrast with 米: raw grain vs. cooked rice/meal.
Water radical 氵 — originally meant 'hot water.' Simplified from 湯. Note: soup is 'drunk' (喝), not eaten.
The four dots 灬 at the bottom are the fire radical (火). Covers both temperature and weather.
Walk radical 辶 + 文. Pairs with 那 nà (that). Colloquially often pronounced zhèi before a measure word.
The copula: links nouns to nouns (A 是 B). Not used before adjectives — 很热, never 是热.
Rice 米 flanked by two bows 弓 — traditionally read as steam curling around cooking rice. Like soup, it takes 喝.
Originally a pictograph of a stemmed ritual food vessel; later borrowed for 'bean.'

meaning: rotten; fermented — used in 豆腐 (tofu)
notes: Meat radical 肉 beneath phonetic 府 fǔ. In 豆腐 it means 'fermented/curdled,' not spoiled.
Walk radical 辶. Simplified from 運.
Strength radical 力 on the right.
Bamboo radical ⺮ on top — baskets were woven bamboo.
Jade radical 王 + phonetic 求 qiú.

meaning: to hit; to play (a sport); to make (a call)
notes: Hand radical 扌. Extremely versatile verb — ball sports take 打, not 玩.
Foot radical ⻊ + phonetic 包 bāo.
Pictograph of two wings facing opposite ways — hence negation. 非常 literally 'not ordinary.'
Water radical 氵.
Water radical 氵 + phonetic 永 yǒng. Pairs with 游.
Pictograph of a net's mesh. Doubles as 'internet.'
Two readings: hái (still/also) and huán (to return something).
Two people side by side — comparison. Core comparative structure.
Enclosure radical 囗 + phonetic 元 yuán. Simplified from 園.
Person radical 亻.
Pictograph of a person in profile with a torso emphasized.
Door radical 户 + phonetic 方 fāng.
Reduplicates as 常常 for 'often.'
Person radical 亻. Polite form is 您 nín.
Neutral tone. Only pluralizes people, never objects.
Multiple lives: public (公园), male animals, and in-law kinship terms.
'Same' — 同学 literally 'same-study.'
Axe radical 斤 — freshly cut wood.
Negated with 没, never 不: 没有 méiyǒu.
A person 大 with a line above — the sky overhead.
Woman 女 + child 子 = good. Also hào 'to like' in some compounds.
Mind the tone: sì (4) vs sǐ (die) — the source of the number's unlucky reputation.
Always bound: 今天, 今年, 今晚.
Simplified from both 歷 (experience) and 曆 (calendar).
Pictograph of a hand holding a record tablet — the scribe.
Common intensifier before adjectives: 真好, 真热.
The most frequent character in Chinese. Neutral tone. Links possessor→possessed and description→noun.
Mouth radical 口 + phonetic 马 mǎ. Turns any statement into a yes/no question. Neutral tone.
Child 子 beneath — a child under instruction. Simplified from 學.
Contains the halberd radical 戈 — originally a weapon name, borrowed for 'I.'
Pictograph of a hand with fingers. Appears as 扌 on character left sides.
Wood radical 木 — early machines were wooden. Simplified from 機.
Metal radical 钅 — coins were metal.
Pictograph of wrapping around something. Noun and verb both.
Water radical 氵. 洗手间 'hand-washing room' is the polite word for restroom.

meaning: room; between; measure word for rooms
notes: A door 门 with sunlight 日 through it — the space between.
Question word — 哪儿/哪里 where, 哪个 which. Compare 那 nà (that).
Pictograph of flames. Appears as 灬 at character bottoms (as in 热).
Pictograph of a cart viewed from above. Simplified from 車.
Stand radical 立 — a place where vehicles stand.
Softened form of 啊 a after vowel sounds. Neutral tone.

meaning: OK; to go; capable; (háng) row, profession
notes: Two readings: xíng (go/OK) and háng (row/trade, as in 银行 bank).
Tree 木 over child 子. One of the most common surnames on earth.
Also the measure word for machines and devices.
Speech radical 讠. Always doubled in everyday thanks: 谢谢.

meaning: cup; measure word for cups of
notes: Wood radical 木 + 不 as phonetic — early cups were wooden.
Core ordering verb. Also marks near-future: 要下雨了 it's about to rain.
Woman radical 女. 奶奶 nǎinai = paternal grandmother.
Use 两 before measure words, 二 èr for counting/numbers: 两杯 but 十二.
Pictograph of a horned ox head. Slang: 牛 = awesome.
Ice radical 冫 (two strokes) + 水 — literally frozen water.
Silk radical 纟 — colors were dye words. Note the ü: lǜ, typed lv4.
Roof radical 宀 — someone under your roof.
Pictograph of rising vapor. The qi of qigong. Simplified from 氣.
Tone sandhi: bù becomes bú before a 4th tone — 不是 bú shì. Negates most verbs; 有 takes 没 instead.
Takes the destination directly: 去 + place, no preposition needed.
Simplified from 書 — originally a hand holding a brush.
Shelter radical 广 + phonetic 占 — commerce under a roof.
Run radical 走 — to overtake. 超 also prefixes slang for 'super.'
超市 is short for 超级市场 'super market' — a direct calque.
Food radical 饣 — originally a lodging that fed guests.
Grass radical 艹. Means both 'vegetable' and 'dish/cuisine.'
Mouth radical 口. Solids are 吃, liquids (soup, congee) are 喝.
Mirror-twin trap: 买 mǎi buy vs 卖 mài sell — one stroke and one tone apart.
Rain radical 雨 — originally scattered raindrops, hence 'scattered/odd bits,' hence snacks.
Appears as 饣 on the left of characters like 饭 and 馆.
Capitalized sense: 韩国 South Korea, 韩语 Korean language.
Pictograph of a tattooed figure — marks, hence writing. Language names: country + 文.
Father radical 父 + phonetic 巴 bā. Doubled in speech: 爸爸.
Two strokes. Also the northern -r ending: 哪儿, 一点儿. Simplified from 兒.
Pictograph of a swaddled infant. As a suffix it's neutral tone: 杯子, 包子.
Woman radical 女 + phonetic 马 mǎ. Doubled in speech: 妈妈.
Kinship precision: 婆婆 is specifically the husband's mother.
Always before the verb, never sentence-final like English 'too.'
Pictograph of a kneeling figure. Note the ü: nǚ, typed nv3. The apostrophe in 女儿 nǚ'ér separates syllables.
Grass radical 艹 — originally 'flower/finest,' borrowed phonetically for England.
Respect prefix, not an insult: 老师 teacher, 老王 'ol' Wang.'
A line through a box's center. 中国 = 'the Middle Kingdom.'
Pictograph of a sprout emerging from soil.
The doubled form 囍 'double happiness' decorates weddings.
Pairs with 喜. Simplified from 歡.
Speech radical 讠 — instruction is spoken.
Pictograph of a person with arms spread wide. 大学 = 'great learning' = university.
Two readings: shù (number) and shǔ (to count).
Person radical 亻. Sounds identical to 她 and 它 — spoken Mandarin doesn't distinguish gender.
拼音 pīnyīn is literally 'spelled sound.'
Two readings that both matter: yuè in 音乐 music, lè in 快乐 happy. Simplified from 樂.
Woman radical 女. A 20th-century invention modeled on English 'she' — identical in sound to 他.
Simplified from 醫 — the box 匚 held an arrow, from battlefield medicine.
Profession suffix: 老师, 律师, 厨师 chef.
The everyday 'yes, that's right.' Also a preposition: 对我说 say to me.
Step radical 彳. Note the ü: lǜ, typed lv4 — same syllable as 绿 green, different character.
Speech radical 讠. Languages take 说: 你说英文吗？
Sheep 羊 over big 大 — a large sheep was beauty/bounty. 美国 = 'beautiful country,' a phonetic borrowing.
Jade 玉 inside a border 囗 — the treasure within walls. Simplified from 國.
Pictograph of the sun. 日本 = 'origin of the sun' — the source of 'Land of the Rising Sun.'

meaning: root; origin; measure word for books
notes: A tree 木 with a stroke marking its root. Measure word for bound volumes.
Neutral tone. Bounces a question back (你呢?) or asks where something is.
